Senses.Explanation: A lion’s claws and teeth names one of the requisites in Fushan Fayuan’s four-item list, beside the ancestral handle, diamond eyes, and the staff of killing and life-giving. Other records say the claws and teeth are exposed or needed to avoid corpses for ten thousand li. The list and later descriptions make it an attributed capacity, not literal animal anatomy.
